brief:
Hundreds of British Jews have signed an open letter accusing the Board of Deputies, the country's main Jewish community body, of "genocide denial," Middle East Eye reported. The signatories challenged the organisation's denunciation of the Green Party and its response to Israeli actions against Palestinians.

The letter represents a significant rift within Britain's Jewish community over how Jewish institutional leadership addresses the conflict. The Board of Deputies has not yet responded to the accusations.

title: British Jews accuse Board of Deputies of genocide denial
